name: 純粋自律神経不全症

summary.text: A rare sporadic neurodegenerative disease characterized by slowly progressive symptoms of orthostatic hypotension (OH), and other symptoms of generalised dysautonomia related to the impairment of the sympathetic component of the autonomic nervous system.
